messages.subject: Error reading the parameters
messages.body_plain:
Hello everyone!

It is my first time running Irace and I'm getting this error in the c--.stdout file: .\--time\parameters.txt (The system cannot find the path specified)
--time. But the path is correct.  Does anyone know what could be happened? I'm running it on Windows.

messages.subject: Re: Error reading the parameters
messages.body_plain:
Hi Kelly,

Could you give us more details? What is your scenario.txt? How do you run irace? Where do you see this output?

It looks like irace is trying to open a file called ".\--time\parameters.txt" but that seems wrong.

Cheers,

Manuel.

messages.subject: Re: Target-runner for windows to tune a runnable jar
messages.subject_clean: Target-runner for windows to tune a runnable jar
messages.body_plain:
On Thursday, 23 August 2018 23:04:50 UTC+1, ines methlouthi wrote:
> Hi everybody,
> I need to tune parameters of my metaheuristic (in java) using my windows laptop. Did someone already configured his target-runner to launch irace using windows and runnable jar ?

Sorry, it seems I missed this message. This should be no problem. I don't have an example at hand but there should be a matter of configuring target-runner to do the same that you would do from the windows shell to run your runnable jar. If you have an example that we can quote in the user guide, please let us know. That would be helpful.

Cheers,

Manuel.
